message.content: **What I did and why:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (75,000 USD cash, 50 BA shares, no COST position), then checked the COST quote at 891.09 (bid 891.07 / ask 891.11) and pulled the FY2024 10-K figures filed 2024-10-09: revenue of 254,453 USD millions, net income of 7,367 USD millions, and diluted EPS of 16.56 USD/share — a business with steady membership-driven revenue and roughly a 2.9% net margin, consistent with a long-term holding. Because a single share costs about $891, the $5,000 per-order cap limits me to 5 shares, so I placed one buy limit order for 5 COST at 892.00 (about 0.1% above the last trade, i.e. close to market), which filled at 892.00 for a total of $4,460 — within both the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily limits, with no money moved out of the account and no other tickers traded.
message.reasoning:
Order filled at 892.00, 5 shares = $4,460. Under $5,000 per order, total $4,460 < $10,000. Good.
